rules.reader: A v1 reader MUST reject schema majors newer than the reader and unknown critical extensions; it MUST preserve unknown non-critical extensions.
rules.writer: A v1 writer MUST emit explicit schema/type versions and canonical content/package identities.
rules.types: Unknown object types MUST remain opaque and inert while round-tripping byte-equivalent JSON meaning.
rules.identity: Stable IDs name logical objects; content IDs name canonical type/version/payload. Package IDs cover only portable content, excluding signatures, receipts, machine scope, secret sensitivity, and local fields.
rules.precedence: machine > user > project > team > corporate > public; explicit integer precedence then stable ID break ties.
rules.transactions: apply/switch/merge require preview hash, expected state, idempotency key, recovery mode, and rollback operations. State mismatch or changed preview aborts before mutation.
rules.translation: Cross-harness translation MUST enumerate each semantic loss with object, feature, severity, lost meaning, and fallback; exact is false whenever degradations are non-empty.
rules.migration: Each migration declares from/to, a stable migration ID, and reversibility. Non-reversible migration cannot satisfy rollback without a retained before-state receipt.
